game.title: South of Midnight
game.blurb: Action-adventure from Compulsion Games, released 2025-04-08. RAWG average playtime: 21 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story: Chapters 1 to 7
chapters.summary: From the night of the flood to the hunt for a missing barman. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Story: Later Chapters
chapters.summary: The rest of the story, chapter by chapter, to its end. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Weaving Upgrades
chapters.summary: Unlocking and fully upgrading General, Strand Pull, Strand Push, Weave and Crouton.

chapters.title: Fighting Haints
chapters.summary: Unravelling Haints, Perfect Dodges and the different Rend attacks.

chapters.title: Hidden Encounters
chapters.summary: Six hidden achievements named after a gator, an owl and spiders, each in a lesser and a greater form. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Collectibles
chapters.summary: Health Filaments, Floofs, Readables and tin flips.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for "South of Midnight". southofmidnight.fandom.com answers the API, with 7 linked pages, all chapter pages from "Chapter 1: Night of the Flood" to "Chapter 7: A Barman is Hard to Find"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 20 of 40 Steam achievements are hidden. Hidden achievements 1 to 14 look like chapter names: the first seven match those Fandom chapter titles and go in the first story chapter; 8 to 14 ("Their Eyes Were Watching" to "Stroke of Midnight") are probably chapters 8 to 14 by position and unlock rate, which needs checking. Hidden 29 to 34 have no descriptions; they were grouped by their names only.
